text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...—
(WHOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I feel it. The surrounding heat... the 
sounds... I can see everything—even 
myself.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Fierce and wild— my unmistakable, true 
nature.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(My heart leaps at the race. Burning for 
victory... This is... who I am!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —The path... I can see it...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
There was no one to stop her!! Duramente 
avenges her loss in the Satsuki Sho! She 
has become a Derby Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaa~~!! DURAMENTE━━━━━!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She got stronger again...!? W-What is 
going on...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Is this...— the strongest Umamusume of the 
Classic generation...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is my—ultimate strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Total defeat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My Classic races end here. ...Looks like 
my revenge will have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no problem! With the summer 
training camp coming up, I'll get even 
stronger.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—The title of the strongest in this 
generation... I'll leave it in your care 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...As for me, next is the Kikuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san is going... overseas, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Guess revenge will have to wait, huh? 
I've gotta get a lot stronger too!
(Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing this voice... I can tell what 
you've achieved."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I must report this to Mother as well.

Amidst the roaring crowd, I couldn't utter 
a single sound. Duramente's run is burned 
into my eyes. Effortless, overwhelming, 
the pinnacle of strength—
If it's her. She is the one who――

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Her cheeks are red.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're feeling thrilled, aren't you? Very 
much so.
choice_data_list: Once they see your brilliant running...!
Once they see your magnificent run...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My body won't hold out like that. For I am 
to show an even greater scenery.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's go fulfill our promise.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —To the world.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associates
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente! Congratulations on becoming a 
Derby Umamusume!

Upon returning to the waiting room, I was 
greeted with thunderous applause. I 
spotted a few faces I'd seen at New Year's 
greetings... It seemed members of the 
family clan had come to watch too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to be there to watch 
Duramente-san's big moment in person.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that really touched my heart! Sports 
really are the best, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've officially become a Derby 
Umamusume... your next stage is...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Given this result, that should be 
plenty.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—After this, we will take on the 'Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.'"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associates
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate A
text_block_list.text: At last, to the world...!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Associate B
text_block_list.text:
"The pinnacle that everyone has dreamed 
of... and yet, could never reach until 
nowâ"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I shall stand at the starting line. Upon 
the pride of this bloodline."
